bienvenida.eslogan: Get and manage your insurance in minutes, with full transparency.

registro.terminos: I accept the terms of service and authorize the processing of my personal data.
registro.terminosTexto: We collect your name, ID, contact details and address to create your account and offer you insurance. We use your data to verify your identity, generate quotes and issue your policies. We don't share it with third parties unless required by law. You can ask us to correct or delete it at any time.
registro.debeAceptar: You must accept the terms to create your account.
registro.confirmarSalida: If you leave now, you'll lose what you wrote in this form.

verificacion.introduccion: We'll ask for a photo of your ID and a selfie. It's to confirm it's really you and fully activate your account.
verificacion.consejo3: Frame the whole document inside the box
verificacion.avisoDatos: These images are only used to validate your identity.
verificacion.instruccionDocumento: Center your ID inside the frame and make sure the details are readable.
verificacion.instruccionSelfie: Look straight ahead and blink slowly.
verificacion.procesandoDetalle: This can take a few seconds.

otorgar.confirmacion: Authorization granted. Your offer is now personalized.

revocar.advertencia: If you revoke it, you lose the personalized offer and your premium may go up.
